versionImpact.rationale: This change additively registers KFD-owned standards metadata and KFD-3 collaboration-interface schemas while keeping existing registry and decision surfaces compatible.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: KFD documents are append-only content coordinates; current decision text changes do not alter a machine-consumed surface.
registry.json keeps schemaVersion 1 and the existing entry shape, including number, id, slug, title, kind, status, path, and url; slug and path values are stable number coordinates.
standards.json and schemas/ add KFD-3 collaboration-interface and witness schema IDs plus KFD-owned concept names for downstream consumers.
The npm package now also publishes standards.json, schemas/, and explicit subpath exports while preserving existing README.md, decisions/, registry.json, site/, and docs/ paths.

summary: KFD v1.0 production promotion is minor-impact because it additively exposes standards metadata and KFD-3 collaboration-interface schema identities for Buildchain and other consumers; existing registry, decision text, and site bundle surfaces remain compatible.
